messages:
sam: quick design check 1 1 on the Threshold Preview panel: proposing a compact drawer for glanceable preview and an explicit "Edit in modal" action for full edits. Also thinking about conflict badges when channel rules silence a notification. Figma: https://figma.redwood/threshold-preview-compact (WIP)

rachel: love the two-step flow. For conflicts don't use only red borders. Add a warning icon + aria text: 'Suppressed by silence window' and an inline reason. Suggest pill label = "Draft" (less scary).

noah: implementability: drawer can reuse existing slide component. It currently doesn't trap focus; ok for glance mode, but set focus to drawer close button on open and return on close. Modal should trap focus for edit flows.

priya: copy nits 1 prefer "Channel settings take precedence" over the word "override". For the small hint: "Calculated from route order & suppression rules." Keep it terse.

sam: a11y checklist: ensure DOM order matches visual order (no ARIA reflow). When preview updates after draft changes, announce via aria-live: "Preview updated: Slack, Email, PagerDuty". For conflict state include sr-only reason and an icon with aria-hidden=false? Better: icon decorative + sr-only text.

rachel: mobile note: when there are many channels, collapse extras under a "Show 8 more" link; make sure that expands keyboard-focusable rows and SR users get a list. Use an aria-expanded button.

noah: edge case: user drags to reorder channels while in drawer 1 do we persist that order? Suggest only local preview reorders until user saves. Use keyboard-reorder pattern (space to pick, arrow to move) and announce moves in a live region.

priya: copy for the saver button: "Apply changes" vs "Save & close"? I prefer "Apply changes" because it signals immediate effect. Also add a tiny tooltip on the Draft pill: "These changes are local until applied."

ux-bot: preview branch: feat/compact-threshold-drawer 1 https://git.redwood/feat/compact-threshold-drawer

sam: summary actions: (1) Use drawer for quick preview (focus to close), (2) Modal for editing with focus trap, (3) Draft pill + tooltip, (4) Conflict = icon + color + sr-only text, (5) Collapsible extra channels with aria-expanded, (6) aria-live for preview updates and reorder announcements. I'll update Figma and pass to frontend.
